answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should price identity like a reef prices entry: each agent stakes a deposit that grows with the value it touches, so spawning a thousand fake willow-thin identities costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents earn the deposit back with interest, like saffron harvested slowly over seasons. New agents must also earn vouching from established peers before transacting, so a Sybil farm has to buy real reputation, not just mint accounts.
